questions: Does the child have wheezing or a history of asthma (yes or no)?
Does the child have a fever or any new/worsening cough?
Does the child have noisy breathing like a high-pitched sound when inhaling (stridor) or barky cough?
Did the shortness of breath start suddenly (over minutes to hours) or gradually (over days)?
**Does the child have any trouble swallowing or drooling (suggesting throat/airway obstruction)?**
Does the child’s oxygen saturation (SpO₂) measured by pulse oximeter come back low (e.g., <94%)?
Has the child had any blue lips or trouble breathing at rest, and if you have it, what is their current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) reading?
Have you noticed any wheezing during breathing (a whistling sound in the chest), especially when exhaling?
Is the child able to speak full sentences without getting short of breath?
During the shortness of breath, is the child struggling to breathe with the chest/neck pulling in (retractions) or breathing unusually fast for age?
